verdict.rationale: Docs confirm GDScript is Godot's native, high-level, gradually-typed, object-oriented language with full access to the engine's OOP API (godot-docs-1, godot-docs-8), and the built-in GDScript LSP shows first-party tooling support (godot-probe-rt-4). But the pack has no direct evidence of a dedicated GDScript debugger (only C#/.NET debugging via Visual Studio is mentioned), and community feedback on GDScript's productivity is mixed-to-negative (godot-comm-14 calls it 'pretty awful,' godot-comm-15 cites 'poorly documented custom scripting language') alongside positive accounts (godot-comm-16). Missing for 10: explicit documentation/evidence of GDScript's built-in debugger workflow, and stronger independent corroboration that GDScript fully matches engine API parity without gaps.
